description: This file defines the main application shell widget for a Flutter expense tracker app. It manages the top-level Scaffold including AppBar, Drawer, BottomNavigationBar, and switching between different primary screens (Dashboard, Reports, Budgets, Goals, Alerts) via tab selection and navigation routes.

classes.name: AppShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides the main structure of the app with a drawer and bottom navigation, managing navigation among screens.

classes.name: _AppShellState
classes.description: State class for AppShell, manages current selected tab, drawer interactions, and navigation logic.

classes.name: _TabInfo
classes.description: Helper class that holds information about each tab including label, icon, and the widget to display.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the AppShell widget.

methods.name: _onTabTapped
methods.description: Handles tap events on the bottom navigation items; updates the current index and performs route navigation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the app shell, including AppBar, Drawer, Body, and BottomNavigationBar.
